title: Bouquet Garni
description: A classic French bundle of aromatic herbs used to infuse stocks, soups, sauces, and stews with subtle herbal flavor before being removed prior to serving.

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Bouquet Garni
steps: Gather the bay leaf, thyme, parsley stems, and any optional herbs or vegetables.
Tie the herbs together securely with kitchen twine, or wrap them in cheesecloth and tie into a compact bundle.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Use in Cooking
steps: Add the bouquet garni to stocks, soups, sauces, braises, or stews at the beginning of cooking.
Allow it to simmer gently, releasing its aromatic flavors throughout the cooking process.
Remove and discard the bouquet garni before serving.

chefTips: Use fresh herbs whenever possible for the best aroma and flavor.
Parsley stems are highly aromatic and should always be included.
Customize the bouquet with rosemary, tarragon, savory, or leek depending on the dish.
Always remove the bouquet garni before serving.
